_comment: Anchor v7 (docs/format-spec.md §9). canonical_bytes: compact JSON, keys sorted, signature excluded, Go encoding/json escaping with HTML escaping on; entry_count, start_seq and end_seq are JSON STRINGS. expected_chain_hash = SHA-512("aleutian.anchor.v7:" || previous_anchor_hash || "|" || len(subject) || subject || "|" || start_seq || "|" || end_seq || "|" || tip_chain_hash), len a 4-byte big-endian byte count. signature: ML-DSA-65, pure, deterministic, context "aleutian.proof.anchor.v7", standard base64, under key (derived from seed_hex; key_id per §9.6). 'text' is the anchor as a file would hold it. Every 'vectors' text MUST verify under key; every 'reject' text (or text_base64, the exact bytes of a text that is not UTF-8) MUST be refused, by whichever check the implementation makes first. message_prefix_hex is the prefix FIPS 204 puts before the canonical bytes for this context, 0x00 || len(ctx) || ctx. Computed in Python (scripts/v4-vectors.py) with dilithium-py, independently of any implementation under test.

vectors.name: first_anchor
vectors.note: the first anchor of a series carries the seed id and the seed hash

vectors.name: range_from_one
vectors.note: a chain whose first entry is at global_seq 1 (v2/v3 permit it): entry_count = end - start + 1

vectors.name: sequence_above_2_pow_53
vectors.note: entry_count and end_seq beyond what a JSON number carries exactly; strings keep them exact

reject.name: signed_with_empty_context
reject.reason: a v7 signature is verified with the context aleutian.proof.anchor.v7

reject.name: signed_with_record_context
reject.reason: a v7 signature is verified with the context aleutian.proof.anchor.v7

reject.name: signed_by_another_key
reject.reason: the signature does not verify under the named key

reject.name: subject_changed_after_signing
reject.reason: the signature does not cover the anchor

reject.name: seed_hash_with_non_seed_id
reject.reason: the seed id goes with the seed hash and no other

reject.name: seed_id_with_non_seed_hash
reject.reason: the seed id goes with the seed hash and no other

reject.name: entry_count_as_number
reject.reason: v7 entry_count is a JSON string

reject.name: range_seq_as_numbers
reject.reason: v7 sequence numbers are JSON strings

reject.name: range_by_entry_id
reject.reason: a v7 range names start_seq and end_seq

reject.name: company_id_instead_of_subject
reject.reason: a v7 subject is under the name subject

reject.name: lone_surrogate_in_subject
reject.reason: an anchor's text is refused if it escapes a lone surrogate (§9.8, §2.0)

reject.name: invalid_utf8_in_subject
reject.reason: an anchor's text is refused if it is not UTF-8 (§9.8, §2.0); text_base64 is its bytes
